verdict.rationale: Fivetran's own docs show some deployment-location choice: the pricing page offers 'Pick any cloud provider (GCP, AWS, Azure)', and the deployment-models docs list a Hybrid Deployment option with customer-managed agents. That suggests some control over where data is processed. No evidence explicitly documents choosing a geographic region or data-residency guarantees. missing for 10: explicit region selection for processing/storage, documented data-residency or sovereignty guarantees, detail on what Hybrid Deployment keeps in the customer's environment, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Pick any cloud provider (GCP, AWS, Azure)
These solutions include the following deployment models: SaaS Deployment... Hybrid Deployment
In the **Hybrid Deployment Agents** tab of the Fivetran dashboard, you can create new agents and view or manage all existing Hybrid Deployment Agents associated with your account.
